name: Arapaima
source:
You're pretty sure that fish don't belong in a hospital. Much less floating around the ceiling of your room in the psych ward.

You were admitted into the psychiatric facility at your local hospital after some intense suicidal ideations. When you start hallucinating fish in your room, you delve into what got you here in the first place.

Your mind.

[From [url=https://nen-kaii.itch.io/arapaima]Itch.io[/url]]
